project.name: app-config
project.description: Shared Spring configuration resources for every executable assembly (application.yml + the application-*.yml profile files, moved here from the app module when app-worker landed - a repackaged Spring Boot jar cannot be a Maven dependency, so "the worker gets the same config" is only possible if config lives in a normal library jar both assemblies depend on). Also carries the EnvironmentPostProcessors (spring.factories: JVM-timezone pin, Windows MCP command defaults) that must run before any bean exists in EVERY entry point, not just the API server's. Edit config here once - app and app-worker both pick it up.
